headline: Calpers Cuts Tech Allocation as AI Valuations Face Scrutiny
summary: California’s public pension fund is shifting capital toward private equity as investors question high technology valuations and the returns on soaring artificial intelligence spending.
why: As the largest U.S. public pension fund, Calpers' asset allocation shifts reflect broader institutional caution regarding tech sector valuations.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Institutional reallocation away from large-cap tech can pressure sector valuations.

why_moved: Institutional skepticism over AI capital expenditure payoffs has prompted large investors to trim exposure to mega-cap tech stocks.
